name: Kinetiq
description: Kinetiq is a non-custodial liquid staking protocol that allows users to stake HYPE tokens on Hyperliquid L1 and receive kHYPE, a yield-bearing representation of staked HYPE that is usable in DeFi.

methodology.UserFees: Percentage of rewards paid to protocol
methodology.Fees: Total unstaking fees and rewards from staked HYPE.
methodology.Revenue: Total fee through 0.1% KHYPE unstaking fee before 2026-04-09, 10% performance fees after that.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: From 2026-04-09, 30% of revenue goes to the treasury, it was 100% before.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: From 2026-04-09, 90% staking rewards distributed to HYPE stakers, it was 100% before.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: From 2026-04-09, 70% of performance fees (which is 10% staking rewards) are used to by back KNTQ.

Fees.kHYPE Staking Rewards: Total staking rewards from staked HYPE.
Fees.kHYPE Unstaking Fees: Total fees from 0.1% KHYPE unstaking fee.

SupplySideRevenue.kHYPE Staking Rewards To Stakers: All staking rewards distributed to HYPE stakers.

Revenue.kHYPE Unstaking Fees: Total fees from 0.1% KHYPE unstaking fee.
Revenue.kHYPE Performance Fees: Protocol takes 10% of staking rewards from 2026-04-09

ProtocolRevenue.kHYPE Unstaking Fees: Total fees from 0.1% KHYPE unstaking fee.
ProtocolRevenue.kHYPE Performance Fees: From 2026-04-09, 30% of performance fees (which is 10% staking rewards) are collected by protocol.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: From 2026-04-09, 70% of performance fees (which is 10% staking rewards) are used to by back KNTQ.

methodology.Fees: Total yield generated by the Kinetiq Earn (vkHYPE) Veda strategy vault.
methodology.Revenue: 20% performance fee charged on vault profits (profit-only, no management or entry/exit fees).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 20% performance fee charged on vault profits.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Net yield (80% of profits) that accrues to vkHYPE depositors.

Fees.kHYPE Earn Vault Yield: Gross yield generated by the Kinetiq Earn strategy vault.

Revenue.kHYPE Earn Performance Fees: 20% performance fee taken on vault profits.

ProtocolRevenue.kHYPE Earn Performance Fees: 20% performance fee taken on vault profits.

SupplySideRevenue.kHYPE Earn Yield To Depositors: 80% of profits retained by vkHYPE depositors.

methodology.Volume: Trading volume on Kinetiq's HIP-3 markets on Hyperliquid. Builder-code volume from the Kinetiq Markets interface is tracked in Kinetiq Interface.
methodology.Fees: Trading fees paid by users on Kinetiq's HIP-3 markets on Hyperliquid.
methodology.Revenue: Kinetiq's deployer-fee cut of its HIP-3 market fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue - retained by Kinetiq.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The remainder of HIP-3 market fees, paid through to Hyperliquid.

Fees.Hyperliquid HIP-3 Markets Fees: All perps trading fees from Hyperliquid HIP-3 markets.

Revenue.HIP-3 Deployer Fees To Kinetiq: Kinetiq's deployer-fee cut of HIP-3 market fees.

ProtocolRevenue.HIP-3 Deployer Fees To Kinetiq: Kinetiq's deployer-fee cut of HIP-3 market fees.

SupplySideRevenue.HIP-3 Fees To Hyperliquid: HIP-3 market fees paid through to Hyperliquid (not retained by Kinetiq).

methodology.UserFees: Percentage of rewards paid to protocol
methodology.Fees: Gross validator staking rewards generated by Kinetiq Launch LSTs.
methodology.Revenue: 10% performance fee taken on LST staking rewards (the full fee accrues to Kinetiq).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Treasury share (default 30%) of the performance fee.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 90% of staking rewards retained by LST holders.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Buyback share (default 70%) of the performance fee.

Fees.LST Staking Rewards: Total staking rewards from Kinetiq Launch LSTs.

Revenue.LST Performance Fees: Protocol takes a 10% performance fee on staking rewards.

ProtocolRevenue.LST Performance Fees: Treasury share (default 30%) of the performance fee.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Buyback share (default 70%) of the performance fee.

SupplySideRevenue.LST Staking Rewards To Stakers: 90% of staking rewards retained by LST holders.

methodology.UserFees: Percentage of rewards paid to protocol
methodology.Fees: Commission charged by the validators kHYPE delegates to, on the staking rewards they produce for kHYPE.
methodology.Revenue: The half of that commission Kinetiq invoices back to each validator operator (invoice_rate_bps, 5000 to date).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: From 2026-04-09, 30% of the invoiced amount is kept by the treasury; it was 100% before.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The half of the commission the validator operators retain for running the nodes.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 70% of the invoiced amount, used to buy back KNTQ for sKNTQ holders from 2026-04-09.

Fees.Validator Commission: Validator commission on the staking rewards produced for kHYPE.

Revenue.Validator Commission Invoiced To Kinetiq: Commission invoiced back to validator operators by Kinetiq.

ProtocolRevenue.Validator Commission Invoiced To Kinetiq: From 2026-04-09, 30% of the invoiced commission is kept by the treasury; it was 100% before.

SupplySideRevenue.Validator Commission To Operators: Commission retained by the validator operators.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 70% of the invoiced commission, used to buy back KNTQ for sKNTQ holders.

methodology.Fees: Trading fees paid in KNTQ on Hyperliquid spot, which is the side of a KNTQ trade the HIP-1 deployer's share applies to.
methodology.Revenue: All of the trading fees paid in KNTQ on Hyperliquid spot. deployerTradingFeeShare on KNTQ is 1.0, so the deployer keeps the whole KNTQ-denominated fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of the trading fees paid in KNTQ on Hyperliquid spot. deployerTradingFeeShare on KNTQ is 1.0, so the deployer keeps the whole KNTQ-denominated fee.

Fees.KNTQ Spot Deployer Fees: Spot trading fees denominated in KNTQ.

Revenue.KNTQ Spot Deployer Fees: Retained in full by Kinetiq as the token's deployer.

ProtocolRevenue.KNTQ Spot Deployer Fees: Retained in full by Kinetiq as the token's deployer.

methodology.Volume: Trading volume routed through the Kinetiq Markets interface's builder codes on Hyperliquid perps. Trades on Kinetiq's own HIP-3 markets are excluded here because Kinetiq Markets already counts them.
methodology.Fees: Builder-code fees paid by users trading on Hyperliquid through the Kinetiq Markets interface.
methodology.Revenue: Builder-code fees, retained entirely by Kinetiq.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue - retained by Kinetiq.

Fees.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: All perps trading fees using Hyperliquid builder code.
